dataset.sampling_method: ECHO discrete soil sampling protocol: one sampling location per kit, using a 30 x 30 x 30 cm soil pit after removing litter and surface material.

sample_id.title: Sample identifier
sample_id.description: Unique identifier of the ECHOREPO soil sample.

sampling_datetime_utc.title: Sampling date and time
sampling_datetime_utc.description: Date and time at which the soil sampling event was recorded, normalized to UTC in ISO 8601 format.

lat.title: Latitude
lat.description: Latitude of the published sample location in decimal degrees using WGS 84 (EPSG:4326).

lon.title: Longitude
lon.description: Longitude of the published sample location in decimal degrees using WGS 84 (EPSG:4326).

country_code.title: Country code
country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code associated with the published sample location.

coordinate_obfuscation_radius_m.title: Coordinate obfuscation radius
coordinate_obfuscation_radius_m.description: Radius, in metres, used to spatially obfuscate the published sample coordinates in ECHOREPO for privacy protection. The published latitude and longitude represent an obfuscated location rather than the exact sampling point.

collected_by.title: Collector identifier
collected_by.description: Internal or pseudonymous identifier associated with the participant or process that collected the record. Publication of this field should be reviewed against the ECHO privacy/consent policy.

data_source.title: Data source
data_source.description: Source system or workflow from which the canonical record was derived, for example the ECHO mobile application.

qa_status.title: Quality-assurance status
qa_status.description: ECHOREPO quality-assurance status assigned to the canonical sample record.

licence.title: Licence
licence.description: Licence statement associated with the row or source data.

image_id.title: Image identifier
image_id.description: Identifier of an image associated with an ECHOREPO soil sample.

image_url.title: Image URL
image_url.description: Public URL from which the image associated with the sample can be accessed.

image_description_orig.title: Image description, original language
image_description_orig.description: Participant-provided image description in the original submitted language.

image_description_en.title: Image description, English
image_description_en.description: English representation or translation of the image description.

image_datetime_utc.title: Image date and time
image_datetime_utc.description: Date and time associated with the image record, normalized to UTC in ISO 8601 format.

parameter_code.title: Parameter code
parameter_code.description: Compact code identifying the measured elemental parameter. The corresponding human-readable definition and semantic URI are given in parameter_definitions.csv.

parameter_name.title: Parameter name
parameter_name.description: Human-readable name of the parameter identified by parameter_code.

result_value.title: Measurement result
result_value.description: Numeric measurement result. The measured property is identified by parameter_code and defined in parameter_definitions.csv.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Unit in which result_value is expressed for this measurement, for example mg/kg.

analysis_datetime_utc.title: Analysis date and time
analysis_datetime_utc.description: Date and time associated with the laboratory analysis, normalized to UTC in ISO 8601 format.

lab_id.title: Laboratory identifier
lab_id.description: Identifier of the laboratory or laboratory workflow responsible for the measurement.

parameter_uri.title: Observed-property URI
parameter_uri.description: Persistent URI identifying the soil property or elemental concentration represented by parameter_code, where a reviewed mapping is available.

marker.title: Molecular marker
marker.description: Molecular marker or assay target used for the microbial biodiversity observation, for example 16S or ITS.

taxon_rank.title: Taxonomic rank
taxon_rank.description: Taxonomic rank at which the microbial abundance result is reported, for example Phylum.

scientific_name.title: Scientific name
scientific_name.description: Scientific name assigned to the microbial taxon by the source biodiversity workflow.

read_count.title: Sequence read count
read_count.description: Number of sequencing reads assigned to the reported taxon for the corresponding sample and molecular marker. This is a sequencing-read count, not a count of organisms.

relative_abundance_pct.title: Relative abundance
relative_abundance_pct.description: Relative abundance percentage reported for the taxon in the corresponding sample and molecular-marker aggregation.

ingested_datetime_utc.title: Biodiversity result ingestion date and time
ingested_datetime_utc.description: Date and time at which the biodiversity abundance row was uploaded/ingested into ECHOREPO, normalized to UTC. The source is sample_taxon_abundance.uploaded_at; it must not be interpreted as the laboratory analysis date.

source_file.title: Source file
source_file.description: Name of the source biodiversity file from which the canonical abundance row was derived.

method_code.title: Analysis method code
method_code.description: Compact code identifying the laboratory analysis method. The method is defined in analysis_methods.csv.

default_unit.title: Default unit
default_unit.description: Default human-readable unit associated with the parameter definition. The actual unit for each measurement is retained in sample_parameters.csv.

parameter_description.title: Parameter description
parameter_description.description: Human-readable description of the parameter represented by parameter_code.

method_name.title: Analysis method name
method_name.description: Short human-readable name of the laboratory method represented by method_code.

method_description.title: Analysis method description
method_description.description: Human-readable description of the laboratory procedure represented by method_code.

procedure_uri.title: Procedure URI
procedure_uri.description: Persistent URI identifying the laboratory procedure represented by method_code, where a reviewed vocabulary mapping is available.

samples.csv.title: ECHOREPO canonical soil samples
samples.csv.description: Canonical sample-level ECHOREPO records for discrete 0-30 cm soil sampling events, including published location, field-estimated soil pH, soil organic matter estimate, earthworm count, visible-pollutant observations, soil structure, soil texture and free-text observations.

soil_ph_field.title: Field-estimated soil pH
soil_ph_field.description: Soil pH estimated with the ECHO paper-strip protocol: mixed soil is added to distilled water until the mixture reaches 14 mL, shaken for 30 seconds, settled for 5 minutes, then a pH strip is immersed for 30 seconds and compared with the ECHO App colour chart.
soil_ph_field.method: ECHO simplified soil pH paper-strip method

soil_organic_matter_estimate_pct.title: Estimated soil organic matter
soil_organic_matter_estimate_pct.description: Estimated soil organic matter (SOM) percentage selected by visually comparing a spoonful of mixed soil with the ECHO App soil-colour chart. This is a field estimate of SOM and must not be interpreted as laboratory-measured soil organic carbon.
soil_organic_matter_estimate_pct.method: ECHO visual soil-colour chart estimation of soil organic matter

earthworms_count.title: Earthworm count
earthworms_count.description: Number of earthworms manually found while breaking apart the soil excavated from the ECHO sampling pit and recorded in the ECHO App.

contamination_debris.title: Debris contamination observation
contamination_debris.description: Numeric ECHOREPO field derived from the ECHO visual-pollutant observation workflow for visible debris. The field protocol requires participants to observe visible fragments and record number and size; the exact encoding of this canonical field still needs to be confirmed.
contamination_debris.method: ECHO visual inspection for visible pollutants in and around the sampling pit

contamination_plastic.title: Plastic contamination observation
contamination_plastic.description: Numeric ECHOREPO field derived from the ECHO visual-pollutant observation workflow for visible plastic. The exact encoding of this canonical field still needs to be confirmed.
contamination_plastic.method: ECHO visual inspection for visible pollutants in and around the sampling pit

contamination_other_orig.title: Other contamination information, original language
contamination_other_orig.description: Participant-provided free-text information about other visible contamination or possible contamination sources, in the original submitted language.

contamination_other_en.title: Other contamination information, English
contamination_other_en.description: English representation or translation of participant-provided information about other visible contamination or possible contamination sources.

pollutants_count.title: Visible pollutants count
pollutants_count.description: Count field associated with the ECHO visible-pollutant observation workflow. The precise set of items represented by this count still needs to be confirmed from the app/export mapping.
pollutants_count.method: ECHO visual inspection for visible pollutants in and around the sampling pit

soil_structure_orig.title: Soil structure, original language
soil_structure_orig.description: Soil-structure class recorded by the participant using the ECHO simplified VESS assessment, in the original submitted language.
soil_structure_orig.method: ECHO simplified Visual Evaluation of Soil Structure (VESS), adapted from Ball et al. (2007)

soil_structure_en.title: Soil structure, English
soil_structure_en.description: English representation of the soil-structure class recorded using the ECHO simplified VESS assessment.
soil_structure_en.method: ECHO simplified Visual Evaluation of Soil Structure (VESS), adapted from Ball et al. (2007)

soil_texture_orig.title: Soil texture, original language
soil_texture_orig.description: Soil-texture class recorded by the participant using the ECHO texture-by-feel workflow, in the original submitted language.
soil_texture_orig.method: ECHO texture-by-feel method adapted from the USDA soil quality guide

soil_texture_en.title: Soil texture, English
soil_texture_en.description: English representation of the soil-texture class recorded using the ECHO texture-by-feel workflow.
soil_texture_en.method: ECHO texture-by-feel method adapted from the USDA soil quality guide

observations_orig.title: Additional observations, original language
observations_orig.description: Additional free-text observations submitted by the participant in the original language.

observations_en.title: Additional observations, English
observations_en.description: English representation or translation of the participant's additional free-text observations.

metals_info_orig.title: Metals information, original language
metals_info_orig.description: Participant-provided free-text contextual information concerning metals or possible metal contamination, in the original submitted language.

metals_info_en.title: Metals information, English
metals_info_en.description: English representation or translation of participant-provided contextual information concerning metals or possible metal contamination.

sample_images.csv.title: ECHOREPO sample images
sample_images.csv.description: Image resources and image metadata associated with ECHOREPO soil samples. Image URLs should resolve to public HTTPS resources before Zenodo publication.

sample_parameters.csv.title: ECHOREPO sample laboratory parameters
sample_parameters.csv.description: Compact long-form elemental concentration measurements associated with ECHOREPO soil samples. parameter_code refers to parameter_definitions.csv and method_code refers to analysis_methods.csv, avoiding repetition of human-readable labels, descriptions and semantic URIs in every measurement row.

sample_biodiversity.csv.title: ECHOREPO sample microbial biodiversity observations
sample_biodiversity.csv.description: Microbial taxonomic abundance statistics by reported taxonomic rank associated with ECHOREPO samples and molecular markers. The ingested_datetime_utc field is an ECHOREPO ingestion timestamp, not a laboratory analysis timestamp.

parameter_definitions.csv.title: ECHOREPO parameter definitions
parameter_definitions.csv.description: Reference table defining the compact parameter codes used in sample_parameters.csv. It provides human-readable names, reviewed semantic URIs, default units, method codes and parameter descriptions.

analysis_methods.csv.title: ECHOREPO analysis methods
analysis_methods.csv.description: Reference table defining the compact laboratory method codes used by sample_parameters.csv and parameter_definitions.csv, including short names, full method descriptions and reviewed procedure URIs where available.
